headline.title: We searched "physiotherapy St George Bristol". Your own website appeared in none of the 16 results.
headline.detail: A national chain's St George clinic, rated 3.9 from 12 reviews, came first. You have 370 five-star reviews and appeared once, as a booking page. Directories took most of the rest.

summary: ROME Physio has 370 reviews, all five stars, and is open seven days from 7am, which is rare anywhere in Bristol. But in our search for physiotherapy in St George, a chain clinic with 12 reviews came first and your own website didn't appear at all.

competitors.name: Ascenti Physio Bristol (St George Health Centre)

search.result: Ascenti's St George clinic came first. Your booking page appeared third. Fresha, WhatClinic, Nuffield Health, Bodyset and other directories filled most of the remaining spots. Your website (romephysiorehab.com) did not appear.
search.meaning: The best-reviewed clinic in the area is the hardest to reach from a search. People meet a chain and directories first.

visibility: In our search for physiotherapy in St George, your booking page appeared, but your own website didn't. A chain clinic came first, and directories that list many clinics took most of the page.
lead: 370 reviews, all five stars: far more than any clinic we found in St George.
Open seven days, 7am–8pm on weekdays and on Sunday mornings.
Next-day appointments and Tecar therapy come up again and again in reviews.
lose: In our search a chain clinic with 12 reviews came first; your website didn't appear.
Directories (Fresha, WhatClinic) show patients other clinics before they reach you.
Your Sunday and early-morning hours aren't visible to someone comparing clinics.

gaps.title: The best clinic is the hardest to find
gaps.detail: People searching by area meet a chain and directories first, even though your reviews are far stronger.

gaps.title: Your seven-day hours go unseen
gaps.detail: Someone injured on Saturday evening who wants a Sunday appointment doesn't learn that you have one.

gaps.title: Women's health and Feldenkrais are hidden
gaps.detail: Specialist services that patients search for by name don't appear for you.

actions.title: Make your own website the first thing people find
actions.why: With 370 five-star reviews, being found is the only thing between you and more new patients.

actions.title: Put 'open 7 days, from 7am' everywhere
actions.why: Doable today: it's your strongest difference and almost nobody else offers it.

actions.title: Keep the reviews coming automatically
actions.why: An automatic request after each visit keeps your lead as other clinics grow.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your team, specialties and reviews on one page, with one-tap booking from any phone.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each visit, so happy patients become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Reminders and recall
plan.detail: Follow-up and maintenance reminders that go out by themselves.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against nearby clinics, and what to do next.

scenario: A builder in Redfield tweaks his back on Saturday afternoon. That evening he searches "physio St George Bristol", sees a chain clinic and a list of directories, and books a Tuesday slot across town. ROME, with a Sunday 7am appointment ten minutes away, never comes up. (Illustration.)
nochange: Your patients keep giving you five stars. But new patients searching in St George keep meeting chains and directories first.
